response.justification: The candidate has extensive experience in software development across multiple languages and domains, but lacks the mandatory 5–10 years of strong C++ development on Windows platforms required for this role. Most of their recent experience is in Node.js, TypeScript, and other modern stacks, with only limited and dated C++ involvement (e.g., National Instruments in 2014–2015). Their domain expertise in capital markets or fixed income is also not evident.
strengths: Strong software craftsmanship and testing methodologies (TDD, CI/CD)
Full-stack development experience with diverse technologies
Proven ability to deliver high-performance, low-latency systems
concerns: Insufficient recent and relevant C++ experience on Windows platforms
No demonstrated domain expertise in capital markets, investment banking, or fixed income
Most recent roles focus on modern stacks (Node.js, TypeScript) rather than C++
